steps.user_message: I met my colleague Mark at the cooking class last night, and we had a great time learning new recipes together.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I met my colleague Mark at the cooking class last night, and we had a great time learning new recipes together.

Sounds great — want to follow up with Mark by email? I can draft and send or save a draft. Here are three quick template options you can pick from (or tell me changes):

1) Short thank-you
Hi Mark — it was great meeting you at the cooking class last night. I had a lot of fun learning the recipes together. Would you like to grab coffee and try one of the dishes this weekend? —[Your name]

2) Share recipes / photos
Hi Mark — I really enjoyed the cooking class last night. I took a few photos/notes of the recipes we learned — would you like me to send them over? If you’re up for it, we could try making the (dish name) together next week. —[Your name]

Hi Mark — great meeting you at the class last night! If you enjoyed that, want to look for another class or a weekend cook-together session? I’m free Saturday afternoons. Let me know what works for you. —[Your name]

Tell me:
- Which template to use (1/2/3) or give edits, and
- Do you want me to send it now or save as a draft? If send, provide Mark’s email or I can search your inbox for “Mark” to find it.

- For RAG and Context memory backends, the response may include retrieved context or conversation history, which is acceptable
